verses.text: 'Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn [us], but He will heal us; He has wounded [us], but He will bandage us.
verses.textZh: 來罷，我們歸向耶和華！他撕裂我們，也必醫治；他打傷我們，也必纏裹。

verses.text: 'He will revive us after two days; He will raise us up on the third day, That we may live before Him.
verses.textZh: 過兩天他必使我們甦醒，第三天他必使我們興起，我們就在他面前得以存活。

verses.text: 'So let us know, let us press on to know the LORD. His going forth is as certain as the dawn; And He will come to us like the rain, Like the spring rain watering the earth.'
verses.textZh: 我們務要認識耶和華，竭力追求認識他。他出現確如晨光，他必臨到我們像甘雨，像滋潤田地的春雨。

verses.text: What shall I do with you, O Ephraim? What shall I do with you, O Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning cloud And like the dew which goes away early.
verses.textZh: 主說：以法蓮哪，我可向你怎樣行呢？猶大啊，我可向你怎樣做呢？因為你們的良善如同早晨的雲霧，又如速散的甘露。

verses.text: Therefore I have hewn [them] in pieces by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth; And the judgments on you are [like] the light that goes forth.
verses.textZh: 因此，我藉先知砍伐他們，以我口中的話殺戮他們；我施行的審判如光發出。

verses.text: For I delight in loyalty rather than sacrifice, And in the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
verses.textZh: 我喜愛良善（或譯：憐恤），不喜愛祭祀；喜愛認識神，勝於燔祭。

verses.text: But like Adam they have transgressed the covenant; There they have dealt treacherously against Me.
verses.textZh: 他們卻如亞當背約，在境內向我行事詭詐。

verses.text: Gilead is a city of wrongdoers, Tracked with bloody [footprints].
verses.textZh: 基列是作孽之人的城，被血沾染。

verses.text: And as raiders wait for a man, [So] a band of priests murder on the way to Shechem; Surely they have committed crime.
verses.textZh: 強盜成群，怎樣埋伏殺人，祭司結黨，也照樣在示劍的路上殺戮，行了邪惡。

verses.text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing; Ephraim's harlotry is there, Israel has defiled itself.
verses.textZh: 在以色列家，我見了可憎的事；在以法蓮那裡有淫行，以色列被玷污。

verses.text: Also, O Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, When I restore the fortunes of My people.
verses.textZh: 猶大啊，我使被擄之民歸回的時候，必有為你所命定的收場。
